dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Will you join me in a game of karuta? It is a fine way to spend leisure time. It will help us both relax, while keeping me sharp and focused.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: The only thing is... It is customary for the winner to be awarded with confectionery, but I do not know whether it can be brought in here...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Hmm, in that case... We can celebrate the victor at the Sacred Sakura some other time. Now, are you ready to be humbled?
